_comment: Give Flutter time to render its first frame. Robo starts crawling immediately and a Flutter app is a blank canvas for the first second or two, which it reads as 'nothing to do' and ends the crawl.
Accept the terms. The checkbox is a Flutter Checkbox, exposed to the accessibility tree; Robo binds it by the label text next to it rather than a resource id, because Flutter has none.
Open the Terms and Privacy dialog, which is reachable without an account and is worth crawling.

Attempt sign-in. On a Test Lab device with no Google account this fails and the app shows an error rather than proceeding — see the blocker note in docs/RELEASE.md. Included so the crawl exercises the failure path, which is worth knowing does not crash.
Everything past this point requires an account. Without the bypass flag the crawl ends here.
